info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Party Authentication API
info.description: The Party Authentication API facilitates the secure authentication of users within the banking ecosystem. This API allows for the verification and updating of authentication details for a specified party, ensuring robust identity management. Typical consumers include banking applications that require real-time updates to user authentication statuses and external services that need to integrate securely into the banking framework. This enhances both user experience and security by allowing seamless updates and maintenance of authentication state.
